title: Immunization Record Standard — Visit Figures for Substitution, Observation, Consent Validity and Registry Deadline
content:
For each Immunization Services vaccination the record standard fixes the vaccination that may be given instead when it is out of stock, whether it may be given at the same visit as other vaccines, the observation minutes recorded after the dose, how many calendar days a signed screening and consent form remains valid for a dose, and the calendar days after the dose by which it is reported to the state immunization registry.

| Vaccination | May be given instead when out of stock | Same visit as other vaccines | Observation (minutes) | Observation with a reported history of severe allergic reaction (minutes) | Consent form valid for (calendar days) | Reported to the state registry within (calendar days after the dose) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination | none | Yes | 15 | 30 | 14 | 3 |
| Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination | Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination | Yes | 15 | 30 | 14 | 3 |
| COVID-19 Updated Vaccination | none | Yes | 15 | 30 | 14 | 1 |
| RSV Older Adult Vaccination | none | Yes | 15 | 30 | 7 | 3 |
| Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination | none | Yes | 15 | 30 | 14 | 3 |
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | none | Yes | 15 | 30 | 7 | 3 |
| Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series | none | Yes | 15 | 30 | 7 | 3 |

## Standard notes

- **Substitution.** The Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination is the only vaccination with a listed substitute, the Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination. "none" means no substitute is listed.
- **Same visit.** Every vaccination may be given at the same visit as other vaccines.
- **Observation.** The patient is observed for 15 minutes after the dose, or for 30 minutes when the patient reports a history of severe allergic reaction.
- **Consent validity.** A signed screening and consent form remains valid for a dose for 14 calendar days for the influenza, COVID-19 and pneumococcal vaccinations and for 7 calendar days for the RSV, zoster and hepatitis B vaccinations.
- **Registry deadline.** A dose of the COVID-19 Updated Vaccination is reported within 1 calendar day after the dose; every other vaccination within 3.

## Hypothetical observation record

A hypothetical patient receiving the Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination who reports no history of severe allergic reaction is observed for 15 minutes; the same patient reporting such a history is observed for 30 minutes.
